name: annwuyn
description: annwuyn — contrastive-rhetoric academic writing method. Linearity, thematic progression, cohesion, dependency, linking scope/distance/explicitness, engagement/appraisal, modality, qualification, economy of language, fallacies. Lecture notes from the course's 38 transcribed sessions and 7 live application reviews, plus a research update (style manuals, reporting guidelines, current test formats). Academic Phrasebank phrase layer (bring your own copy). Includes scholarship-application, research-paper and APA psychology modes (complete manuscripts from inputs to submission file, every section, citations, format audit, term papers, posters, talks, ethics proposals).
